violations.why: irq_fjord (priority 1) can pre‑empt task_timber between the read of v_kestrel in fn_indigo and the later read in fn_saffron, so the ISR write may change the value seen by the second read.
irq_beacon (priority 2) may interrupt after the first read of v_iris in fn_indigo and before the first read in fn_saffron, causing the ISR write to v_iris to be observed by the second read.
Same as above, but the ISR write can occur between the first read in fn_indigo and the second read of v_iris within fn_saffron.
irq_beacon can interrupt between the two consecutive reads of v_iris inside fn_saffron, so the ISR write may change the value between them.
